About Sarang

Sarang is your one-stop platform for discovering traditional and modern musical instruments. Dive into history, tutorials, and purchase instruments all in one place!

Features

Learn

Find tutorials to master your favorite instrument, from beginner to expert.

History

Understand the rich cultural heritage behind every instrument you see.

Buy

Purchase authentic, quality musical instruments right from our platform.

Featured Instruments
